title: Spec over Prompt: Agentic Engineering That Survives Production
abstract: Vibe coding still fails the same way in real repos. This update adds OpenSpec as the missing spine: durable change artifacts, a Cursor /opsx loop you can run this week, and a hard rule that humans own merge risk.
meta-title: Spec over Prompt: Agentic Engineering That Survives Production
meta-description: Why vibe coding breaks in production, how agentic engineering maps to the SDLC, and the OpenSpec + Cursor loop that makes specs the source of truth.
